item.title: Magilumiere Co. Ltd. Volumes 1-12 Manga Review
item.content:encoded: Although it’s a bright and breezy magical girl manga with an adorable cast and plenty of fun, flashy battles, at its heart, <i>Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.</i> is a pointed criticism of dehumanizing mega-corporate culture.
